extracted.name: Venom cocktail
extracted.description: Mix up this venom cocktail made with vodka, whiskey, WKD Blue and orange juice – originating in Glasgow, this striking green drink is a party favourite
ingredient_lines: 275ml WKD Blue or other similar alcopop
125ml orange juice or enough to top up
instruction_lines: Fill a pint glass with ice. Pour in the vodka, Southern Comfort or whiskey and the WKD Blue or alcopop. Stir to mix, then pour over the orange juice until it fills the glass.
